evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep asks 'And it looks like we have a good contact number for you as the 512-653-3554' and confirms 'Katie and garden @gmail.com' — name Katie appears in email and is acknowledged.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote offered before diving into probing. Rep goes straight into details.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Rep asks 'There's two that are always at the top tier and that's the movers not being on time and then to damage to their items are any of these a concern for you?' This is asked before any logistics probing begins.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer responds 'we've worked with you guys many times in the past and that hasn't been an issue but definitely, would wanna make sure that people are on time' — rep acknowledges with 'Yeah, I love hearing that' but never asks a follow-up like 'tell me more about that' or probes deeper into the customer's specific concerns. One acknowledgment, no layering.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep says 'Awesome, well we appreciate you returning it to us for your move' but never summarizes or reflects back the concerns Katie raised.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Rep delivers no version of the On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage. No permission lead-in asking to share how they work on reliability and damage protection.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Rep opens with 'well we appreciate you returning it to us for your move and then let's see did we help you move into the storage unit' — references prior move context but no explicit 'What items in this move are you most concerned about?' concern-led opening. However, rep thoroughly gathers: storage unit details (5x10, internal, first floor), parking distance (20 feet to building door, 50 feet inside to unit), full ceiling, three-bedroom house destination (804 Edgecliff, 2000 sq ft, two stories), driveway parking (20 feet), no stairs. All major logistics captured despite no formal concern-led opening.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items' and never asks about box count or typical volumes.
evidence_quotes.value_days: No value-days discussion occurs. Call is routed to specialist before pricing is discussed.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: No pricing discussion, no rate lock, no ask for the business. Rep routes to specialist callback.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking occurs on this call. Rep says 'Do you mind if I have someone give you a callback' and 'Someone will reach out to you shortly.' This is a clean transfer to a specialist, not a booking.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details (two addresses, square footage, stories, parking distances, number of rooms, storage unit configuration, multiple stops) in a methodical, organized way that sets up an accurate specialist estimate.
coaching_note: On walkthrough-routing calls, deliver both Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) in step 3 before handing off to the specialist — the promises land early while the customer is paying full attention and answer the concern they just named, and they are graded even on walkthrough calls under v4.
